### Birthplace of the King
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/birthplace-of-the-king
Passage: Micah 5:2
Points:
- Bethlehem was an unassuming village whose Hebrew name means "house of bread," yet God singled it out centuries beforehand as the ruler's birthplace.
- Worldly rulers like Caesar Augustus believed they were executing their own agenda, but God sovereignly guided history to fulfill prophetic scripture.
- The focal point of redemption unfolded not in imperial courts or political halls, but in a lowly manger.

### God’s Way - Truth For Life - December 11
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-december-11-2023.html
Passage: Micah 5:2
Points:
- Micah surprised his audience by announcing the Messiah would originate from humble Bethlehem rather than prominent Jerusalem.
- Scripture repeatedly reveals God’s pattern of choosing the weak, small, and overlooked rather than human power.
- The obscurity of Jesus' birth in a feed trough foreshadows His humble path to the cross.
- Believers who feel unimportant or lacking in influence should be encouraged that God consistently uses the lowly for great purposes.
